newsitem.title: CANADA: CIBC sets C$300 mln 4.5 pct bonds due 1999.
newsitem.headline: CIBC sets C$300 mln 4.5 pct bonds due 1999.

text.p: Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce on Tuesday set a C$300 million, 4.5 percent bond due December 6, 1999, lead manager CIBC Wood Gundy Securities Inc said.
The issue was priced at C$99.811 with an offering yield 4.568 percent and a spread of 22 basis points over the Government of Canada benchmark bond.
The benchmark bond is the Government of Canada 9.25 percent bond due December 1, 1999.
The new issue, which pays interest on June 6 and December 6, will be dated and delivered on December 6. The issue is non-redeemable prior to maturity and is not for sale in the United States.
